    Unified Negative Log-Likelihood Evaluator for State-Space Models

    loglik_ssm_core.Rd

    Evaluates the objective function (negative log-likelihood) for numerical optimization across supported structural model types ("okun", "philips", or "taylor"). Maps unconstrained optimizer parameters into structural economic coefficients, constructs state-space system matrices, and routes computation to the appropriate Kalman filter engine.

    loglik_ssm_core(theta, ssm, return_full_res = FALSE, set_silent = TRUE)

    Arguments

    theta

    Numeric vector of unconstrained parameters passed by the numerical optimizer.

    ssm

    A list defining the standardized structural model specification, containing name, initial states (rho_guess, sigma_guess), input matrices (data$Y, data$X), and matrix generator functions (builders).

    return_full_res

    Logical. If FALSE (default), returns the scalar negative log-likelihood for optimization. If TRUE, returns the complete list of filtered states, covariance matrices, and mapped parameters.

    set_silent

    Logical. If TRUE (default), suppresses diagnostic parameter logs.

    Value

    If return_full_res = FALSE, returns a numeric scalar representing the negative log-likelihood (or 1e10 if estimation fails). If return_full_res = TRUE, returns the complete Kalman filter output list augmented with param_debugs.

    Details

    Unconstrained parameter vector theta is mapped to structural parameter bounds via param2model_gen. Dynamic builders assemble system matrices (\(\mu_t, H, M, N, \nu_t, G\)), routing to kalman_filter_taylor for Taylor rule models or kalman_filter_core for Okun and Phillips curve models. If numerical instability or non-finite values occur, a large penalty value (\(10^{10}\)) is returned.

    See also

    kalman_filter_core, kalman_filter_taylor, param2model_gen
